findings.title: Possible duplicated bounded-tree traversal policy
evidence: Category and Wiki parsers independently initialize count/seen, recurse through children, enforce 5000-node/32-depth bounds, and reject repeated IDs.
Projection fields differ, but the shared traversal/guard policy is copied.
findings.risk: A future change to count/depth/duplicate-ID handling must be made in both parsers and can drift.
findings.suggestion: Consider a small shared bounded-tree traversal helper if this policy changes; keep explicit per-kind projections and avoid speculative class hierarchies.
findings.counterEvidence: Separate projections are readable, current policies agree, and existing limits bound recursion. No demonstrated functional defect or compulsory immediate refactor.
findings.baseline: User-supplied Fowler possible-smell baseline, not a documented repository prohibition.
